title: Coverage
description: snapshot/coverage.json -- per-collector access/evidence accounting (ADR-018 / engineering plan section 7.2): access requested, rights present in token claims, rights expected, access actually verified, evidence status, and affected controls/report sections.

accessRequested.description: Scopes/roles the profile asked for on this collector's behalf.

rightsPresentInToken.description: Scopes/roles actually present in the acquired token's claims -- may differ from accessRequested (e.g. admin consent not granted for a requested scope).

rightsExpected.description: The least-privileged scope(s)/role(s) this collector's endpoints document as required, independent of what was requested or granted.

accessVerified.description: Whether a real endpoint call actually succeeded, not just whether the token claims looked sufficient. A Global Reader label never implies coverage on its own (section 7.2).

affectedControlIds.description: Control IDs that depend on this collector's evidence and are affected if evidenceStatus is not 'Collected'.
